entries.heading: There is hereby appropriated $500,000 to carry out
ancestors: DIVISION A—AGRICULTURE, RURAL DEVELOPMENT, FOOD AND DRUG ADMINISTRATION, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2021
entries.text:
Sec. 776.  There is hereby appropriated $500,000 to carry out 
section 224 of Subtitle A of the Department of Agriculture 
Reorganization Act of 1994 (7 U.S.C. 6924) as amended by section 12504 
of Public Law 115-334.

[[Page 134 STAT. 1230]]
